phrases.transliteration: Drink mah tee, groot dih mor-reh.

phrases.afrikaans: Trek aan, pak die wêreld aan.
phrases.transliteration: Trek ahn, pak dih vair-ruld ahn.

phrases.english: Fuel my body, light and good.
phrases.afrikaans: Voed my liggaam, lig en goed.
phrases.transliteration: Food mah likh-gahm, likh en hood.

phrases.english: Hear the story, in every sound.
phrases.afrikaans: Hoor die storie, in elke klank.
phrases.transliteration: Hoor dih sto-rie, in elk-eh klank.

phrases.english: The rhino charges, with a mighty rumble.
phrases.afrikaans: Die renoster storm, met 'n magtige gebrom.
phrases.transliteration: Dee reh-no-ster stoorm, met 'n mahg-tee-keh geh-brom.

phrases.english: The hippos wallow, in cool mud.
phrases.afrikaans: Die seekoeie rol, in koel modder.
phrases.transliteration: Dee say-koo-ee-yuh rol, in kool mod-der.

phrases.english: The baboons chatter, in the trees.
phrases.afrikaans: Die bobbejane kwetter, in die bome.
phrases.transliteration: Dee bob-beh-yah-neh kwet-ter, in dee boh-meh.

phrases.english: Seed the idea, let it bloom.
phrases.afrikaans: Saai die gedagte, laat dit blom.
phrases.transliteration: Sai di he-dag-te, laat dit blom.

phrases.english: Stand firm, but bend a little.
phrases.transliteration: Stahn fas, mah boy-kh uh bee-t-shee.

phrases.english: Taste the adventure, sip the calm.
phrases.afrikaans: Proe die avontuur, sluk die rustigheid.
phrases.transliteration: Proo di ah-fon-toor, sluk di roos-tigh-heid.

phrases.english: The village breathes, slow and steady.
phrases.afrikaans: Die dorp asemhaal, stadig en bestendig.
phrases.transliteration: Dee dorp aa-sem-hahl, stah-dagh en bestendigh.

phrases.english: A shared meal, a deeper bond.
phrases.transliteration: Un deel vahn kos, un dee-per bahnd.

phrases.english: The river sings, its ancient song.
phrases.afrikaans: Die rivier sing, sy ou lied.
phrases.transliteration: Dee ri-veer sing, sigh ow leed.

phrases.english: Hear the echo, of new words.
phrases.afrikaans: Hoor die eggo, van nuwe woorde.
phrases.transliteration: Hoer dee eh-kho, vahn nyoo-veh vor-deh.

phrases.english: The rhythm of life, in Afrikaans.
phrases.afrikaans: Die ritme van lewe, in Afrikaans.
phrases.transliteration: Dee rit-meh vahn leh-veh, in Ah-free-kahns.

phrases.english: Unravel the meaning, word by word.
phrases.afrikaans: Pak die betekenis uit, woord vir woord.
phrases.transliteration: Pahk dee beh-teh-keh-nis oyt, voord fer voord.

phrases.english: Gentle unfolding, like a flower bud.
Each moment, has its own pace.
phrases.afrikaans: Elke oomblik, het sy eie pas.
phrases.transliteration: El-ke oom-blik, het sy ey-e pas.

phrases.english: A calm heart, awaits its turn.
phrases.afrikaans: 'n Kalm hart, wag op sy beurt.
phrases.transliteration: 'n Kalm hart, wag op sy beurt.

phrases.english: Let the past, be the past.

phrases.afrikaans: Hierdie las, val van my af.
phrases.transliteration: HEER-dee las, val fan my af.

phrases.english: A crisp apple, under the sun.

phrases.afrikaans: Warm brood, om in te doop.
phrases.transliteration: Warm brood, om in te doop.

phrases.english: Life's a garden, tend your bloom.
phrases.afrikaans: Die lewe is 'n tuin, versorg jou blom.
phrases.transliteration: Dee leh-veh is 'n toon, fer-soorg yoh blom.

phrases.english: Find your spark, let it gleam.
phrases.afrikaans: Vind jou vonk, laat dit skyn.
phrases.transliteration: Vind yoh vonk, laat dit skine.

phrases.english: Hear the melody, in every word.
phrases.afrikaans: Hoor die melodie, in elke woord.
phrases.transliteration: Ho-or dee meh-lo-dee, in el-kuh wo-o-rd.

phrases.english: Speak the rhythm, feel the pulse.
phrases.afrikaans: Spreek die ritme, voel die pols.
phrases.transliteration: Spreek dee rit-muh, fool dee pols.

phrases.english: Grow your understanding, bit by bit.
phrases.afrikaans: Groei jou begrip, bietjie vir bietjie.
phrases.transliteration: Gro-ee yo-wuh be-greef, beet-jee fur beet-jee.

phrases.english: A shared glance, says it all.
A cool cap, for the sun.

phrases.transliteration: un spin-neh-KOP se WEB, VANG LIG.

phrases.afrikaans: Een, klein tree, vir die mensdom.
phrases.transliteration: Een, klain treh, feer dee mens-dom.

phrases.english: Three, cheers loud, for the team.
phrases.afrikaans: Drie, toejuigings hard, vir die span.
phrases.transliteration: Dree, too-juy-ghings hard, feer dee span.

phrases.english: Four, wheels turn, on the road.
phrases.afrikaans: Vier, wiele draai, op die pad.
phrases.transliteration: Feer, wee-leh draai, op dee pad.

phrases.english: Your mind, it needs rest too.
phrases.afrikaans: Jou gemoed, dit het rus nodig.
phrases.transliteration: Yow ghe-mood, dit het rus noh-dik.

phrases.english: Sunshine on your skin, a gentle warmth.
phrases.afrikaans: Sonskyn op jou vel, 'n sagte hitte.
phrases.transliteration: Sons-kine op yow vel, 'n sahf-te hit-te.

phrases.english: A quiet walk, clears the clouds.
phrases.afrikaans: 'n Stil stap, maak die wolke weg.
phrases.transliteration: 'n Stil stap, mahk de vol-ke vekh.

phrases.english: Click a button, learn a skill.
phrases.transliteration: Klik an knoppie, leerr an vaardigheed.

phrases.english: A gentle breeze, a peaceful mind.
phrases.transliteration: a sah-teh bree-see, a kalm ghe-mood
steh-reh vat ski-ter, a sti-leh ver-von-deh-ring

phrases.afrikaans: Ek is gevul, met suiwer, genot.
phrases.transliteration: Ek is ge-FUL, met SOO-wehr, ge-NOT.

phrases.english: Let's chart a new course, forward.
phrases.afrikaans: Kom ons beplan 'n nuwe roete, vorentoe.
phrases.transliteration: Kom ons beplan 'n nuwe roete, vorentoe.

phrases.afrikaans: Wonderlik om jou te sien, vriend.
phrases.transliteration: Vun-der-lik om yau teh seen, vree-ent.

phrases.english: Listen to your inner whisper, softly.
Feel the steady pulse, within you.
phrases.afrikaans: Voel die bestendige pols, binne jou.
phrases.transliteration: Fool de bes-ten-di-ge pols, bin-ne yoe.

phrases.english: Wind in your hair, victory near.
phrases.afrikaans: Wind in jou hare, oorwinning naby.
phrases.transliteration: Vint in yoh ha-reh, oo-ver-vin-ning na-ba.

phrases.english: Feel the burn, taste the win.
phrases.afrikaans: Voel die brand, proe die oorwinning.
phrases.transliteration: Fool dee brand, proo dee oo-ver-vin-ning.

phrases.afrikaans: Hart klop vinnig, gees vlieg hoog.
phrases.transliteration: Hart klop fin-nigh, Ghees vleegh hoogh.

phrases.afrikaans: Elke tree, vertel sy eie storie.
phrases.transliteration: El-keh treh, fer-tel sigh ey-yeh sto-ree.
